subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When invoked against an existing ungated record, the skill shall resume at the frontier re-asking nothing the record holds; a frozen record shall never be edited — a reopened direction starts a fresh record citing it.
rationale: records are the durable state; freeze-at-merge is the class rule
fit_criterion: kill-and-resume fixture: zero re-asked rulings; reopen fixture: predecessor byte-identical, fresh record cites it
